script.scriptText:
--lua sim = require('sim') simROS2 = require('simROS2')
-- Pioneer 3-DX ROS 2 interface (CoppeliaSim 4.x, Lua simulation script) -- in : /cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/msg/Twist) -- out: /ultrasonic_sensors (std_msgs/msg/Float32MultiArray, 16 values) -- or, if this plugin build lacks Float32MultiArray, -- /ultrasonic/s0 ... /ultrasonic/s15 (std_msgs/msg/Float32 each)
local WHEEL_RADIUS = 0.0975 -- m local WHEEL_BASE = 0.331 -- m local MAX_RANGE = 1.0 -- m, published when nothing is detected local CMD_TIMEOUT = 0.5 -- s, stop if /cmd_vel goes silent
local function findObjects(root, prefix) local found = {} for _, h in ipairs(sim.getObjectsInTree(root, sim.handle_all, 0)) do local alias = sim.getObjectAlias(h, 0) if string.sub(alias, 1, #prefix) == prefix then table.insert(found, h) end end return found end
function sysCall_init() robot = sim.getObject('..') leftMotor = findObjects(robot, 'leftMotor')[1] rightMotor = findObjects(robot, 'rightMotor')[1] sensors = findObjects(robot, 'ultrasonicSensor') if not leftMotor or not rightMotor then error('Could not find leftMotor/rightMotor inside the robot') end sim.addLog(sim.verbosity_scriptinfos, 'Found ' .. #sensors .. ' ultrasonic sensors')
linVel, angVel = 0.0, 0.0 lastCmdTime = 0
cmdSub = simROS2.createSubscription('/cmd_vel', 'geometry_msgs/msg/Twist', 'cmdVelCallback')
-- Try the array message first; fall back to 16 Float32 topics if unsupported local ok, pub = pcall(simROS2.createPublisher, '/ultrasonic_sensors', 'std_msgs/msg/Float32MultiArray') if ok then sonarPub = pub sim.addLog(sim.verbosity_scriptinfos, 'Publishing /ultrasonic_sensors (Float32MultiArray)') else sonarPubs = {} for i = 1, #sensors do sonarPubs[i] = simROS2.createPublisher('/ultrasonic/s' .. (i - 1), 'std_msgs/msg/Float32') end sim.addLog(sim.verbosity_scriptinfos, 'Float32MultiArray not supported by this plugin -> publishing /ultrasonic/s0..s15 (Float32)') end sim.addLog(sim.verbosity_scriptinfos, 'Pioneer ROS 2 interface ready') end
function cmdVelCallback(msg) linVel = msg.linear.x angVel = msg.angular.z lastCmdTime = sim.getSystemTime() end
function sysCall_actuation() if sim.getSystemTime() - lastCmdTime > CMD_TIMEOUT then linVel, angVel = 0.0, 0.0 end local vLeft = (linVel - angVel * WHEEL_BASE / 2) / WHEEL_RADIUS local vRight = (linVel + angVel * WHEEL_BASE / 2) / WHEEL_RADIUS sim.setJointTargetVelocity(leftMotor, vLeft) sim.setJointTargetVelocity(rightMotor, vRight) end
function sysCall_sensing() local distances = {} for i = 1, #sensors do local res, dist = sim.readProximitySensor(sensors[i]) if res > 0 and dist < MAX_RANGE then distances[i] = dist else distances[i] = MAX_RANGE end end if sonarPub then simROS2.publish(sonarPub, {data = distances}) elseif sonarPubs then for i = 1, #sonarPubs do simROS2.publish(sonarPubs[i], {data = distances[i]}) end end end
function sysCall_cleanup() if cmdSub then simROS2.shutdownSubscription(cmdSub) end if sonarPub then simROS2.shutdownPublisher(sonarPub) end if sonarPubs then for i = 1, #sonarPubs do simROS2.shutdownPublisher(sonarPubs[i]) end end end

--lua function sysCall_init() sim = require('sim')
-- do some initialization here end
function sysCall_actuation() -- put your actuation code here end
function sysCall_sensing() -- put your sensing code here end
function sysCall_cleanup() -- do some clean-up here end
